priorEvidence.workingHypothesis: The historical Script106 high-reward class is the melee direct-full-bounty path rather than a concurrent second reward source.

directTelemetry.meleeMessageMeaning: Explicit replay user message indicating a melee hit on hit_entindex.
directTelemetry.fatalDamage: Secondary confirmation using Damage message victimHealthNew and attacker identity.

design.positiveClass: Script108/109 GROUND_PLUS_SECOND_COMPONENT, reinterpreted prospectively here as DIRECT_FULL_BOUNTY_CANDIDATE.
design.attackTypeClaim: An explicit MeleeHit message targeting the exact Trooper near death is direct attack-type evidence. It is not dependent on reward magnitude, CItemXP absence, or player distance.

interpretation.meleeHit: Direct MeleeHit message targets exact Trooper entity near the death tick.
interpretation.fatalDamage: Damage-message confirmation is secondary because NPC fatal-damage coverage may be incomplete.
interpretation.creditedPlayer: Where fatal attacker pawn identity is available, it is compared against the independently derived credited last-hitter.
interpretation.semanticLimit: This is replay-observed attack-type evidence and not source-code proof of the engine reward branch.
